Crop of the Players Committee card image [[:File:V1-L-r2d2-original.gif]] (before the change to [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V) (Errata)]]): pixels 0–745 × 602–1039 of the 745×1039 image (coordinates scaled to the earlier image’s own size; pixels unchanged). Cropped only; no other edits.

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/r2d2.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018).
